coordinateConvention: Zero-based absolute source pixels. Geometric height is bottomY-topY; inclusive raster occupancy additionally counts the endpoint pixel. Cell-local coordinates use recorded adaptive sourceRegion, not an assumed 418px grid. Source image pixels are unchanged.

visibleOpening.note: Dark personnel entrance; actual same-x vertical opening column. Both selected endpoints are visible; outer trim is excluded.

groundPlaneEstimate.method: Robust alpha>128 foreground bottom-contour line fit on each ground axis; the 95th-percentile positive residual adds the physical fence post feet below raised rails. Visually checked against the lower post tips or stone-wall base. Side corners are projected foot-line estimates near the outer corner posts, with ±3px painted/post-width uncertainty; the hidden rear corner is not observed. Registration uses opposite-side foot-line midpoint, never silhouette-bottom alignment.
